_what: The Disapprove reasons on the approval page. Each reason points at the upstream step(s) that caused it — as far upstream as it goes — and the tool that owns that step. A tool can differ by lane: {"video": ..., "image": ..., "carousel": ..., "creator": ..., "*": fallback}. Add a reason by adding a row; ids never change once used (learnings.jsonl keeps them). Steps are the twelve shared steps (lab/work-queue/WORK-QUEUE-damon.md).

reasons.label: Hook weak / doesn't stop the scroll
Words wrong / off-brand / claim not allowed
Person or product looks wrong / AI slop / faces
Something else (say it in the note)
